description: Create new Attio records across supported resource types when a scoped tool is not available. Prefer create_company or create_deal for common company/deal writes. Never update existing records, attach files, or bypass required fields. May require explicit user approval from the host. Requires resource_type plus record_data that matches discover_record_attributes output. If validation fails, call discover_record_attributes to confirm required fields and enums. If a select/status value is rejected, call get_record_attribute_options for that attribute to list valid options before retrying.

resource_type.description: Type of resource to operate on. Standard types: companies, people, deals, tasks, lists, records, notes. Custom objects (e.g., "funds", "investment_opportunities") are also supported after running `attio-discover attributes -a`.

name: create_record
